name: freeshow-mcp
description: Control and build FreeShow church presentations: slides, songs, scripture, themes, services.
long_description:
Lets Claude operate FreeShow (freeshow.app): present and navigate slides, import songs, build branded scripture slides (NIV, KJV, BSB and more — ESV with a free Crossway key), apply your church's theme, organize the service order, run announcement loops, QR codes, lower thirds, and move a setup to another computer.

Requires FreeShow with **Settings → Connections → API** turned on.

freeshow_host.title: FreeShow computer
freeshow_host.description: Where FreeShow runs. Leave as localhost if it's this computer.

esv_api_key.title: ESV API key (optional)
esv_api_key.description: Free key from api.esv.org, only needed for ESV scripture slides.
